tools.name: list_ndis_services
tools.description: Use this when mapping a requested NDIS support to directory service categories before searching. Returns category IDs, names, synonyms and source links. Therapy services is a broad category, not proof that a provider offers a specific therapy. Do not use for NDIS billing item codes or funding advice

tools.name: search_ndis_providers
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to find or compare Australian NDIS providers by support category, state, city, suburb, postcode or name.
